findings.assessment: Claims the objective is dominated by position from raw weights, then immediately admits those magnitudes do not establish cost contributions.
The claimed unread 0.01-0.29 s interval includes prediction-query measured endpoints at 0.01-0.03 s. The revision corrects this.
Confuses the update-32 controller time 0.32 s with its next measured endpoint at 0.33 s when calling the selected state the fastest measured state.

The rollout demonstrates a lower speed for one alternative input, but its instantaneous optimum does not prove bounded achievable endpoint speed or that no other input/strategy can meet the criterion. Values at index 4 are at 0.008 s, distinct from the 0.01 s endpoints.
Describes full stopping tally as unselectable even though exact stopping counts were in the accepted initial report; catalog display limitations must not become evidence-absence claims.
